author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Prepare consented coarse GPS context and Core Location adapter
details: Add a standalone Swift package with explicit sharing consent, authorization and active-scene gating, rounded-only cache, fix age/accuracy checks, independent expiry and at-most-1-Hz local handoff. Add a proposed separate GPS contract CR without changing protected shared contracts or sending GPS in depth packets. End-to-end telemetry and Apple/device acceptance remain pending.
validation: 13 portable Swift XCTest cases passed on official Swift 6.0.3 Linux with complete strict concurrency and warnings as errors. Conditional Core Location/UIKit code was excluded; no Xcode/device test claimed. Checked publishing runs repository structure, shared unittest discovery, generated log and whitespace checks; actual results reported in the PR.
